filter_interaction.limits: Exploratory interaction contrast on 32 paired cases; bootstrap interval is descriptive, especially at boundary outcomes.

analysis.limits: Reserved evaluation within this migrated simulator. Original checkpoint training overlap is unknown. Exact paired statistics assume independent sampled initial-condition seeds. No arbitrary simulator snapshot or real-world safety guarantee. Audit failures must be investigated before causal claims.

physical_audit.artifact_audit: passed all episode states/actions, frozen filter settings and source hashes

frozen_test_contract.scope: 64 reserved seeds per selected filtered controller; 32 unfiltered ablation seeds
frozen_test_contract.limits: Held out from this adaptation and selection study; overlap with the released checkpoint's original training data is unknown. Source hashes are checked before each job. Compare observed prefixes rather than assume simulator snapshot restoration.

ledger.scope: New adaptation study; all complete worker runs counted exactly once. Earlier shared foundations are separate and not free data.

stopped_startup_trial.reason: Concurrent simulator startup consumed CPU and slowed the existing pilot from approximately 25 seconds per full episode to roughly 170 seconds. Both check workers were still initializing and had created no episode directory. Deliberately stopped this startup trial; preserve it and use sequential fresh-process evaluation.
stopped_startup_trial.limits: Elapsed times include the interval until this stop audit; concurrent worker times overlap. This does not establish that parallel Isaac execution is impossible.

earlier_shared_foundation.limits: The baseline report includes the final 60-step acceptance in its separate engineering record, not its autonomous total; it appears once here. Several initial migration attempts were not fully instrumented, including an initial environment run and a pre-step integration failure with unknown partial query count. These are not assigned zero cost. Original checkpoint pretraining and earlier unrelated projects are outside this study.

ledger.elapsed_time_scope: Worker timers include simulator/model startup and episode execution. Aggregate them as measured process time, not elapsed project wall time. Search, validation, batch, handoff waiting and worker timers overlap; never sum these levels. Offline diagnostics and stopped concurrent startup may overlap physical work. Video/analysis time is separate.
ledger.query_units: Calls per named component; uncertainty_ensemble counts an ensemble invocation. Offline conditional samples count individual evaluations rather than batched kernels.

video-improvement.selection: First held-out seed in numerical order satisfying improvement; not a representative-frequency claim.
video-improvement.source: Recorded front RGB frames, nearest-neighbor enlargement and synchronized labels; no new simulation.
video-improvement.limits: Individual illustration selected by the stated rule; frequencies come from the full outcome table. Terminal frames are held and labelled. No arbitrary snapshot restoration or post-termination stability claim.

video-failure.selection: First held-out seed in numerical order satisfying failure; not a representative-frequency claim.
